note: The camera now spins: hold a camera button (or hold an arrow key) and the view slowly turns at 45 degrees per second, RuneScape-style, until you let go — the world turns around you while you stay centered. A quick tap still jumps exactly 90 degrees like before, and holding left and right together cancels out instead of fighting. Movement stays world-relative at every angle, and your exact camera angle is saved and restored (old saves keep their 90-degree step as 0/90/180/270).
